svg.title: Sixteen mathematical background graphics
svg.text: 16 original vector diagrams · shown at full strength

g.title: Brillouin torus
g.desc: A parametric torus with its two independent cycles highlighted; a geometric model of a two-dimensional Brillouin zone.

g.title: Möbius band
g.desc: A ruled strip with a half twist. Its two parameter edges join into one continuous boundary.

g.title: Linked Hopf fibres
g.desc: Eight fibres of the Hopf map stereographically projected from the three-sphere. Each pair is linked once; gaps preserve their projected over-under ordering.

g.title: Trefoil knot
g.desc: A smooth tubular embedding of the (2,3) torus knot, with depth-sorted faces making its three crossings legible.

g.title: Bloch sphere
g.desc: A unit sphere, coordinate axes, computational-basis poles and a normalized pure-qubit state vector. Back-facing curves are attenuated.

g.title: Conical band crossing
g.desc: Two energy sheets proportional to plus or minus the magnitude of momentum, shown as touching wireframe cones. An illustrative two-band dispersion, not measured data.

g.title: Euler winding
g.desc: The planar vector (cos 2θ, sin 2θ) turns twice around one circuit of the origin. A schematic texture relevant to Euler band crossings.

g.title: Band-node braid
g.desc: Three smooth node trajectories with three exchanges and explicit crossing order, illustrating multiband node braiding.

g.title: Surface-code stabilizers
g.desc: A square-lattice bulk schematic with data qubits on edges, one four-qubit Z plaquette and one four-qubit X star. No finite-code boundary conditions are asserted.

g.title: Toric-code lattice
g.desc: A square cellulation of a torus with data qubits at edge midpoints and two noncontractible cycles highlighted. The qubit placement and periodic identifications form a toric-code lattice.

g.title: Fano plane
g.desc: The seven points and seven three-point lines of PG(2,2). Nonzero binary vectors label points; every line has vector sum zero. Related to the Hamming and Steane code constructions.

g.title: GHZ preparation circuit
g.desc: A Hadamard on the first of four zero-state qubits and a chain of three CNOT gates prepare (0000 plus 1111) divided by the square root of two.

g.title: Stabilizer measurement
g.desc: Four data-controlled CNOTs accumulate their computational-basis parity in a zero-state ancilla; measuring the ancilla in Z measures the four-body Z stabilizer.

g.title: Kagome lattice
g.desc: A nearest-neighbour graph of corner-sharing triangles, a standard frustrated-spin geometry, with one six-site loop highlighted.

g.title: Band-energy contours
g.desc: Computed energy contours of the two-band toy Hamiltonian d dot sigma, with d = (sin kx, sin ky, 1.2 + cos kx + cos ky). Periodic momentum space is shown in oblique projection. Not measured data.

g.title: Temporal network
g.desc: Three schematic snapshots of the same eight-node network, with changing edges and dotted inter-layer correspondences. No empirical network is implied.
